## Epic ID

Example: P3

## Canonical roadmap

Reference the matching section in:

`docs/ROADMAP_EPICS.md`

## Scope

Summarize the implementation scope.

## Dependencies

List prerequisite epics or decisions.

## Acceptance gates

Copy the canonical gates from `docs/ROADMAP_EPICS.md` and keep them synchronized.

## Evidence

Link or record:

- source changes
- migrations
- tests
- CI runs
- security regressions
- browser evidence
- physical-device evidence
- documentation updates

## Blockers

List only active blockers.

## Status

Select one:

- [ ] PLANNED
- [ ] IN_PROGRESS
- [ ] BLOCKED
- [ ] DONE

Do not mark DONE until all required acceptance gates are satisfied.
